newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Heavy to convert $700 mln into yen.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Heavy to convert $700 mln into yen.

text.p: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd said on Monday it plans to liquidate all its dollar-denominated deposits, currently standing at about $700 million, and convert them into yen.
"We will liquidate our dollar-denominated deposits by the end of March in order to make up for some shortfalls in cash at home," a spokesman for the company said.
The spokesman said Mitsubishi Heavy had a total of about $1.13 billion of dollar-denominated deposits at the end of March 1996, and it had spent $600 million on payments in the current fiscal year.
"The company is planning to liquidate the remaining $500 million of those deposits and an additional $200 million of deposits," he said.

He declined to say if the liquidation was due to an expectation that the dollar's recent gains against the yen had peaked. Mitsubishi Heavy's shares ended morning trade at 869 yen on the Tokyo stock market, down 48 yen from Friday's close.
